headline: NarxStat platform launched in Uzbekistan to monitor prices of products, fuel and housing
summary: The National Statistics Committee has launched NarxStat, a platform to monitor product, fuel and housing prices and inflation dynamics by region. Users can access calculators and interactive charts without registration.
why: Official price and inflation data inform monetary policy, wage setting and business planning. The National Statistics Committee is Uzbekistan's state statistics agency.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda mahsulotlar, yonilg‘i va uy-joy narxlarini kuzatish uchun NarxStat platformasi ishga tushirildi
